info.title: NERVE synthetic memory research API
info.description: Synthetic-only evidence retrieval and optional loopback inference. No live clinical deployment or persistent KV restoration. Scope fixed by offline grants.

200.description: Untrusted synthetic synthesis or abstention; always requires review

schema.description: Configured inference requires query and limit. Clinic/patient-only shape is retained for the default unconfigured 501 response.

post.description: Optional host-configured local-model synthesis using approved synthetic evidence. Absent adapter returns 501; no KV restoration.
